fieldNotes.location: Roster address 3450 W 2100 S is wrong (a generic industrial-park point). Resolved to the real Frito-Lay West Valley City facility at 6301 W 4700 S, West Valley City UT 84118 (40.6662,-112.0402). Confirmed via web research and satellite + 2024-10 Street View: large industrial complex with red Frito-Lay logo signage, rooftop snack-food processing equipment, corn silos, and a steam plume.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Roster types this as a Distribution Center; the site is actually a combined production plant + distribution operation (produces Doritos, Lay's, Ruffles). Audited as the freight/truck yard regardless.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire property enclosed by tall ornamental steel security fencing (clear in Street View). A single controlled driveway off 4700 S leads through a gate; a gate/checkpoint is visible in the driveway in zoom-20 imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly staffed guard booth visible at the gate; a small checkpoint structure is present in the driveway but cannot be confirmed as a manned shack from imagery. Flagged uncertain; treated as remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~10+ trailers backed in on the south face plus a west-face dock bank; total estimated ~45 doors. Approximate — building is large and some faces obscured by rooftop equipment.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large east-side trailer drop yard with 40+ trailers in rows, plus additional trailer rows on the west and north — well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the south face and the west face are physically separate clusters on different building faces.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry driveway and large open paved staging area inside the gate give ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed entering the property; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant/warehouse plus a smaller separate building to the south.
